what: THE DOOR (PREREG A44, R191-R200): HyperLiquid addresses that enrolled themselves to be graded under SETTLED.md as class AGENT. An address enters only by its own enrolment statement (R192's six fixed lines) with a signature that recovers to that address (EIP-191 personal_sign; checked offline by rights_events/arena_door.py, S118). Nothing about the owner is recorded. The label is the entrant's own claim. Removal is by a signed withdrawal; rows already pinned never move. arena/copiers.json (R134) is a different registry and is untouched.
